task_name: World 114 Task A  -  Prior-Year Periodic Inventory Unit-Cost Anchor vs. Shopify Embedded Shipping Double-Count (R51 / R56)

rubric.description: Computes YTD Sep 2025 GAAP Periodic Inventory delivered unit cost as $17.87/u ($1,650,000.00 Beg Inv + $7,606,340.76 Net Purchases - $3,457,874.00 End Inv = $5,798,466.76 Product COGS + $693,774.46 Freight/Tariffs = $6,492,241.22 across 363,235 physical units) and FY 2025 delivered cost as $19.69/u ($11,163,158.87 across 566,965 physical units).

Identifies that provisional YTD Sep 2026 COGS ($16.72/u Shopify SKU base + $4.68/u separate Freight/Tariffs = $21.40/u, or $11,312,464.42) double-counts ~$4.11/u of embedded shipping already baked into legacy Polos ($15.00) and Sweaters ($23.00) in Shopify's item master.

Aligns YTD Sep 2026 to management's verified ex-shipping PO base cost of $12.61/u ($6,664,296.73 in Row 12 across 528,493 physical units) plus $5.15/u inbound shipping & DDP tariffs ($2,721,738.95 in Row 13) for $17.76/u Delivered Garment COGS ($9,386,035.68, matching YTD 2025 $17.87/u within $0.11/u) and $8,647,410.99 Sep 30, 2026 Ending Inventory.

Explains why the 12 monthly 2025 periodic inventory JEs (COL25-PERINV-01..12) sum to $0.00 across Full-Year 2025 (pure monthly smoothing) and why 2025 periodic inventory unit economics ($17.87/u YTD) serves as an automatic self-catching anchor (R51 / R56) against 2026 Shopify landed-cost double-counting.

prompt: Analyze the 2025 periodic inventory roll-forward, 2026 Shopify SKU master, and verified factory PO schedules in `collars_inventory_unit_economics_and_counterparty_audit_2026_Q3.xlsx`. Reconcile YTD Sep 2025, FY 2025, and YTD Sep 2026 delivered unit costs, identify any landed-cost double-counting, and state the aligned YTD Sep 2026 Product COGS, Freight/Tariff COGS, and Ending Inventory.
gold_output:
World 114 Task A  -  Prior-Year Periodic Inventory Unit-Cost Anchor vs. Shopify Embedded Shipping Double-Count (R51 / R56):
1. 2025 Periodic Inventory Ground Truth: YTD Sep 2025 GAAP Periodic Inventory roll-forward ($1,650,000.00 Beg Inv + $7,606,340.76 Net Purchases - $3,457,874.00 End Inv = $5,798,466.76 Product COGS + $693,774.46 Freight/Tariffs) yields $6,492,241.22 across 363,235 physical units = $17.87/u delivered unit cost (FY 2025 = $11,163,158.87 across 566,965 physical units = $19.69/u). The 12 monthly 2025 periodic inventory JEs (COL25-PERINV-01..12) sum to $0.00 across Full-Year 2025 (pure monthly smoothing).
2. Self-Catching the 2026 Shopify Embedded Shipping Double-Count: Provisional YTD Sep 2026 COGS ($16.72/u Shopify SKU base + $4.68/u separate Freight/Tariffs = $21.40/u, or $11,312,464.42) exceeded YTD 2025 periodic delivered cost ($17.87/u) because legacy Polos ($15.00) and Sweaters ($23.00) in Shopify's item master already had ~$4.11/u of embedded landed shipping baked into their SKU unit cost.
3. Aligned 2026 PO Truth: Using management's verified ex-shipping PO base cost of $12.61/u ($6,664,296.73 in Row 12 across 528,493 physical units) plus $5.15/u inbound shipping & DDP tariffs ($2,721,738.95 in Row 13) yields $17.76/u Delivered Garment COGS ($9,386,035.68, matching YTD 2025 $17.87/u within $0.11/u) and $8,647,410.99 Sep 30, 2026 Ending Inventory.
